dashboard.label: Reading Validation
dashboard.description: Raw 15-minute ZENTRA readings. datetime is the logger measurement time. Compare Precipitation rows with value > 0 to https://zentracloud.com/#/dashboard_detail/z6-30302. Use Rainfall Totals to sum those interval samples by logger_day.

search.query: `zentra_weather_search` | stats count by device_sn | sort device_sn
`zentra_weather_search` device_sn="$device_sn$" | stats count by measurement | sort measurement

table.title: Measurements present (must match chart titles on the ZENTRA dashboard)

search.query: `zentra_weather_search` device_sn="$device_sn$" | stats latest(units) as units latest(aggregation) as rollup_to_day_or_week latest(sensor_name) as sensor_name count as samples by measurement, measurement_canonical | sort measurement

table.title: Precipitation intervals with rain (value > 0) — match these datetimes to ZENTRA tooltips

search.query: `zentra_precip_rain` device_sn="$device_sn$" | table datetime, logger_day, measurement, value, units, tz_offset | sort - datetime

table.title: All 15-minute samples for the selected measurement

search.query: `zentra_weather_search` device_sn="$device_sn$" measurement="$measurement$" | table datetime, logger_day, _time, device_sn, measurement, value, units, tz_offset, sensor_name, mrid, error_flag | sort - datetime
